name: DFW Cubing Summer 2022
information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Note: This competition is on a Sunday.

# ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.***

- Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSummer2022#19500-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSummer2022#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.
